title: Claude, Codex and Cursor on One Canvas: MagicPath
description:
Comment "BUILDER" and I'll send you the link 👇

Claude, Codex and Cursor can now work on the same canvas at once. In MagicPath's new Builder plan, 10 dollars a month with unlimited external-agent calls, you set a task visually and the agents connect, see your design and write code against it. One builds, one cleans up components, one runs tests, in real time. Two-way sync is the magic: change the canvas and it hits your repo, change the repo and the canvas updates. The agent calls are billed by your own tool, not MagicPath.

#ai #coding #buildinpublic #devtools
